description: **The owner can grant one more review round**: A job blocked after 3 rounds has no way forward, though docs/REVIEW.md says the owner decides: `policy` is a required check, the ruleset has no bypass, `jobs check` refuses a fourth round (`MAX_ROUNDS`), and a reviewer who must fix a conflict cannot write `merge` (rule A). Add a way for the owner to grant one more fresh round for one job. The grant must be something only Liam can merge (`meta/` or `decide/`), never `plan/`, which merges itself, and never the job's own branch. W45 is the first use. Raised: W45 review round 3 and Liam's answer, 2026-11-06
title: The owner can grant one more review round

budget_lifts.why: fix round 1: B1 changed the rule, and the proof ran end to end on W45 through the real judge, on top of a build of 75
